race.comment: POWER OF SUCCESS (4) raced just off the speed then battled on fairly to finish fifth last start over 1640m at Toowoomba. Raced here earlier in the prep and was beaten narrowly. Form a bit patchy of late but in a modest affair he looks well placed to salute. Veteran BILL PEYTO (11) dropped back to a BM50 last time out and collected a ninth career win over today's trip at Coonabarabran. Placed at three of five runs here at this distance. Nicely in with the claim and should give a good account again. MARALAGO (13) settled near the tail and only got warm when the race was all over in a 1400m BM58 at Dubbo recently. Better placed out to the mile and from a nice draw should get all the favours. THE GREAT ARMADA (6) turned in an eye-catcher at his latest appearance over 1400m at Warren. Three-time winner at the mile - leave him out at your peril. MEDDLESOME (3) returned to the winner's circle at Gunnedah last time. An extra 200m should pose no problems.
